commit.message:
fix(transcripts): load UTF-8 BOM config and checkpoint documents (#4352)

* fix(transcripts): load UTF-8 BOM JSON documents

Signed-off-by: Rudy Celekli <47457359+rudycelekli@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(transcripts): read the BOM config in the Codex and Grok Bot paths too

The Codex and Grok Bot installers and the Grok Bot INDEX writer read the same transcript-watch.json as the watcher. Route them through readJsonFileWithBom so a BOM-saved config behaves the same everywhere: the installers no longer throw, and the INDEX writer no longer silently sees no watches.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
